images.caption: A prison cell door from the outside, showing the spy hole in the centre of the door. A  curved mark to the right of the spy hole was created by prison guards leaning on the door with a bent arm as they looked through the spy hole at the prisoner(s) inside the cell. The shape created by the side of guards' hands is immediately above the spy hole.

images.caption: The Alte Synagoge (Old Synagogue) at Waagegasse 8 in the old town of Erfurt. Seen from the Northwest. Built around 1100 and until the pogrom of 1349 the synagogue of the Jewish community. Then used as a warehouse and in the 2nd Half of the 19th Century gastronomically. Today exhibition space on the culture and history of the Jewish community of Erfurt in the Middle Ages.
images.alt: The Alte Synagoge (Old Synagogue) at Waagegasse 8 in the old town of Erfurt. Seen from the Northwest. Built around 1100 and until the pogrom of 1349 the synagogue of the Jewish community. Then used as a warehouse and in the 2nd Half of the 19th Century gastronomically. Today exhibition space on the culture and history of the Jewish community of Erfurt in the Middle Ages.
